source_manifest_reference: Complete bounded proposal text in the conversation

items.source_item: Artifact readiness gate before dependent work
items.intent: Prevent downstream work from starting with missing or ambiguous inputs
items.rationale: Required artifacts need identity, provenance, classification, ownership and acceptance evidence, but only approved baselines require immutability; evolving drafts must remain possible under change control.
items.protected_outcome: Reliable input readiness without freezing learning
items.follow_up_trigger: A project has a multi-artifact or supplier-dependent work package

items.source_item: Strict construction-like sequencing for all engineering stages
items.rationale: Only real dependency edges are strict. Independent implementation, verification-design, assurance and documentation lanes remain parallel and converge at controlled integration points.
items.verification_reference: Dependency-aware sequencing section and flow-plan dependency contract
items.follow_up_trigger: A plan defines dependent and independent work lanes

items.source_item: Local staging buffer for context, binaries, embeddings and containers
items.intent: Reduce repeated retrieval, latency and cloud cost
items.rationale: Staging is useful only with version, provenance, classification, licence, integrity, freshness and invalidation. Derived embeddings are never promoted to an undeclared source of truth, and secrets remain excluded.
items.protected_outcome: Fast reusable supply without stale or unauthorised context
items.verification_reference: Controlled staging, cache and context-supply section
items.follow_up_trigger: A project proposes a reusable cache or retrieval index

items.source_item: Drum-Buffer-Rope with FIFO queue and WIP equals one for HIL, GPU and licensed tools
items.rationale: DBR is optional. Capacity is measured per resource; priority uses risk, value, readiness, aging, deadline and setup cost. WIP one applies only to a true single safe slot, and blind FIFO can mishandle urgent or aging work.
items.protected_outcome: Stable bottleneck flow without unsafe universal queue rules
items.follow_up_trigger: A named constrained resource and observed service data exist

items.source_item: Presidio, lint and syntax checks in every pre-commit hook
items.intent: Reject defective or sensitive input early
items.rationale: Use the cheapest deterministic checks matched to the failure and data path. Presidio is an unadmitted PII-support candidate, does not prove IP removal and is not a universal code gate.
items.protected_outcome: Early error prevention without false privacy assurance or excessive friction
items.verification_reference: Early error prevention section and admitted-service boundary
items.follow_up_trigger: A classified data path defines representative detection fixtures

items.source_item: Dedicated quarantine directory for AI-generated code
items.intent: Keep untrusted candidates out of authoritative product state
items.rationale: A candidate namespace is useful, but a directory name is not isolation. Access, execution, promotion, deterministic verification, final diff, independent review and human authority are required.
items.verification_reference: Quarantine control and E1 traceable-candidate contract
items.follow_up_trigger: AI or another untrusted source creates a project artifact

items.source_item: SBOM as immutable delivery note containing commit, toolchain, bench calibration and approval
items.rationale: SBOM covers software components and is only part of a broader release/evidence manifest. Toolchain, bench, calibration, verification, anomalies, approval and recovery references belong in the broader pedigree record.
items.protected_outcome: Complete delivery provenance without misusing SBOM terminology
items.follow_up_trigger: A project prepares a controlled release or delivery

items.source_item: Immediate automatic rollback after every failed pipeline step
items.intent: Return quickly to a known-good state
items.rationale: Blind rollback can destroy diagnostic state, repeat unsafe physical actions or corrupt non-transactional systems. Failure first stops or isolates the flow; rollback runs only when prevalidated, state-safe and authorised, otherwise forward recovery or manual containment is selected.
items.verification_reference: Failure containment and recovery rule plus flow-plan recovery contract
items.follow_up_trigger: A project proposes an automated recovery action

items.source_item: Universal incoming, src and release repository directory structure
items.intent: Separate raw, active and approved artifacts
items.rationale: Separation of states is required, but physical paths depend on repository type, ALM, binary store and project toolchain. The Company policy defines semantics and the external project maps them to its own controlled locations.
items.protected_outcome: Clear artifact states without imposing one incompatible folder tree
items.verification_reference: Company/project workspace boundary and controlled flow states
items.follow_up_trigger: A project establishes its repository and artifact-store layout

items.source_item: No merge without automated checks and explicit lead approval
items.intent: Prevent incomplete work entering an authoritative baseline
items.rationale: Material release and controlled baseline changes require applicable deterministic checks and accountable approval. Low-consequence reversible work uses the proportional process-strength contract; one generic lead must not replace domain, safety, legal or professional authority.
items.verification_reference: Roles and decisions plus adaptive process-strength rules
items.follow_up_trigger: A project defines merge and release protections
